title: [CUDA][B200][Inductor] Inductor Loop Ordering After Fusion (#162030) causes > 70% perf. regression
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Observing > 70% E2E performance regression on a stable diffusion workload on GB200 machines with #162030, performance is restored either by checking out the previous commit or setting `TORCHINDUCTOR_LOOP_ORDERING_AFTER_FUSION=1`. Is this a known issue as I see it is not enabled by defauled in `fbcode`?

### Versions

Source builds following #162030
